name: עָמוֹק
summary: A head of the priests who came up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua (Neh 12:7), whose house in the days of Joiakim was led by Eber (Neh 12:20). The name is the adjective עָמֹק “deep”, written in full; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Sallu, עָמוֹק, Hilkiah, Jedaiah: these were the heads of the priests and their brothers in the days of Jeshua.”
The adjective עָמֹק “deep”, the form of the name.

note: Takes p.dm.af (2 tokens). The reading “deep” takes the name as the adjective עָמֹק in full spelling; no verse gives its meaning.
